concerns.text: T002 (unchecked) provides unit tests for 'filtering, context sampling, JSD stability, gradient inversion, BLEU/similarity, and Wilcoxon' in code/data/ and code/models/test_*.py, but the filtering and context-sampling implementations are (re)built in T003 ('Implement/repair code/data/download.py and preprocess.py'). Tests are consumers of the implementation; running T002 before T003 leaves tests for modules that do not yet exist or were rejected. Either move the filtering/context-sampling test subset after T003, or state explicitly that T002 covers only already-implemented modules (training loop, metrics, stats) with the data-pipeline tests folded into T003's verification.

The T004 validation step consumes the manifest, so the producer and consumer paths must agree; also note spec FR-006/SC-006 name 'data/teacher_logits_raw.jsonl' — pick one canonical path and use it consistently in the task, manifest, and validation script.
